summary: Public projects created on 6 November 2025: 1 repo and 4 models.
intro: A pattern for AI assisted development from a single long prompt joined four fine-tuned image models on Hugging Face: two for realistic Israeli street scenes, plus character LoRAs of a plush sloth in a dinosaur costume and a handmade donkey.

projects.name: Claude Spec Starter
projects.description: Pattern for AI assisted development starting from one (long) user prompt

projects.name: Dinosaur Sloth
projects.description: LORA for Flux created from photos of a cute sloth plushie wearing a dinosaur costume!

projects.name: Herman Poppleberry
projects.description: Character LORA created from photos of a cute donkey plushie (handcrafted in Storrs, CT!)

projects.name: Jerusalem Images
projects.description: A Flux LORA for generating realistic images of Jerusalem, Israel trained on a dataset of streetscape images taken around West Jerusalem during the summer of 2025 (images: Daniel Rosehill).

projects.name: Tel Aviv Street Style
projects.description: You should use TLVSCENE to trigger the image generation.
